Institutes and Think Tanks & Roundtables are two distinct offerings from IPMI.
Institutes feature dynamic panel discussions, keynote presentations, practical case studies, and interactive think tanks, complemented by pre-scheduled private business meetings. They bring together CxOs from across North America in an intimate, luxury setting over two-and-a-half days.
Think Tanks & Roundtables, on the other hand, provide a platform for sharing insights, tools, and resources to help drive organizational success, serving as a go-to outlet for addressing changing priorities and perspectives.
